# Environment variables

| Variable | Effect |
| -------- | ------ |
| `KONFORM_COLOR` | Default for `--color`; the flag takes precedence. Control when coloured output is used |
| `NO_COLOR` | When set and not empty, disables colour in `--color auto` mode, even if `FORCE_COLOR` is set ([no-color.org](https://no-color.org)). |
| `FORCE_COLOR` | When set and not empty, enables colour in `--color auto` mode even when the output is not a TTY ([force-color.org](https://force-color.org)). |
| `CLICOLOR_FORCE` | When set and not `0`, enables colour in `--color auto` mode even when the output is not a TTY ([bixense.com/clicolors](https://bixense.com/clicolors/)). |
| `CLICOLOR` | `CLICOLOR=0` disables colour in `--color auto` mode. |
| `TERM` | `TERM=dumb` disables colour in `--color auto` mode. |

With `--color auto` (the default), the first rule that applies wins: `NO_COLOR` turns colour off; `FORCE_COLOR` or `CLICOLOR_FORCE` turns it on; `TERM=dumb` or `CLICOLOR=0` turns it off; otherwise colour is emitted when the output is a TTY.
